name: Quiliano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quiliano (a castle on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Quiliano, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Quiliano arms — castle on red, crowned, within branches
